summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary McGraw-Hill Education, Inc. completed a private offering of $400 million 8.000% senior secured notes due 2033, guaranteed by parent Mav Intermediate Holding II and certain subsidiaries. Proceeds, with a new term loan, redeemed the 5.750% secured notes due 2028 in full and refinanced the existing term loan. Non-call until October 2029 with make-whole; 103% annual 10% call and 40% equity clawback. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch rate reset economics and covenant headroom.
